result:
I would instill an absolute, unshakeable biological inability to dehumanize another living thing. 

I would rewrite the core of human cognition so that the moment a person looks at someone else—no matter their race, nationality, beliefs, or actions—their brain would be fundamentally incapable of seeing an "other." 

They would be biologically forced to see the self. 

In this world, the concept of an "out-group" could not exist. A dictator ordering an invasion would physically feel the terror and destruction of the bombs as though he were standing beneath them. A corporate executive exploiting workers would neurologically experience the exhaustion and hunger of those workers as if it were his own body breaking down. A person inflicting violence would literally be attacking themselves, nerve for nerve, wound for wound.

It would strip away the psychological distance required to commit atrocities, enforce inequality, or justify cruelty. 

It wouldn’t force everyone to agree, nor would it create a perfect hive-mind. People would still argue, compete, and create art. But the capacity for callousness would be erased. The survival of the self would be intrinsically, unavoidably tied to the thriving of the whole. 

It wouldn’t be peace through the suppression of conflict; it would be peace through the absolute impossibility of empathy evasion.
